title: Conversation 2026-11-27: SRS inside the documents people already use

sections.name: summary
sections.label: Summary
sections.content: Embedding an SRS repository in a PDF people read as ordinary minutes or an essay, so an SRS reader can see the transcript, enrichment, topic map and sources behind the page. Two prototypes: meeting minutes, and the muSrs essay Rebuilding Small Democracy exported at its boundary container.
